📢 Presentación general

    
        📘 Introducción a la materia
    
    
        English II is a course designed to consolidate and expand the skills developed in English I, helping students communicate with greater accuracy and confidence. Throughout the course, students will work with more complex grammatical structures such as past tenses, comparatives and superlatives, and future forms, while continuing to strengthen their vocabulary. Reading and listening activities will include longer and more detailed texts, allowing students to improve comprehension and become more familiar with real-life and academic English.
In addition, English II places a strong emphasis on speaking and writing. Students will participate in conversations, short presentations, and dialogues that simulate everyday and professional situations, as well as write paragraphs and brief compositions with clearer organization and coherence. By the end of the course, learners are expected to understand and produce more complete messages, express opinions, describe experiences, and interact in English with greater fluency, preparing them for higher levels of language study and future professional use.
    



    
        🧩 Metodología
    
    
        
            Leer el texto base y responder preguntas de comprensión.
            Crear un podcast reflexivo sobre el tema de autonomía.
            Compartir en el foro tu experiencia personal.
